title: P-preauth1: empty claimset matches every requester
description: room-policy-04 §4: an entry matches when 'every Claim.claim_id' has a corresponding claim. With an empty claimset that is vacuously true, so the entry preauthorizes ANY requester (including every BasicCredential user, which carries no claims) and shadows all later entries. Readings: (a) literal: empty claimset matches everyone; (b) empty claimset never matches; (c) reject empty claimsets at decode. Chosen: (a), implement as written, and document it prominently as a policy-author hazard (security note in rustdoc). wg item filed.
